gate: docs/campground-curation.md: private adds need RV Life price_level <= 2 AND star_rating >= 4 (price half lifted only in national-park gateway areas), then per-entry inclusion vetting, live web presence, seasonal/membership exclusions, waterfront defaults down
method: Per state: Good Sam directory rows (type not PUBLIC_PARK) + unmatched OSM campsites with no DB entry within 2 km -> look up each on RV Life -> gate -> research INLINE one candidate at a time, writing each verdict here as it is made (project_pre_playbook_private_gap). Also the CA residual check: RV Life commercial rows named lake|reservoir|fairground|expo|harbor|district|county|city with no entry within 2 km.

AL.estimate: ~70 private RV parks unmatched in OSM, heaviest in Baldwin County (Foley/Gulf Shores/Orange Beach) and around Lake Guntersville/Smith Lake; also Warden Station Horse Camp (USFS, horse)

CT.estimate: 135 unmatched named OSM campsites read: no local-government RV campground; the rest are youth/Scout/church camps, state backcountry and horse camps, and ~40 private campgrounds (Strawberry Park, Odetah, Hemlock Hill, Witch Meadow...) - private gap outside this pass

IL.estimate: ~60 private unmatched (Chain O'Lakes, Rock River, southern IL); IL holds only 34 private entries

IN.estimate: ~40 private unmatched (Brown County, Shipshewana/Middlebury, northern lakes); IN holds 33 private entries

KY.estimate: ~30 private unmatched (Red River Gorge, Kentucky River, Cumberland Lake); KY holds only 27 private entries

LA.estimate: ~90 Good Sam private LA parks unmatched (Lake Charles/Sulphur, Breaux Bridge, Northshore clusters); LA holds 73 private; many are workforce/monthly - filter hard

ME.estimate: ~150 unmatched named OSM campgrounds in ME are private (Bayley's, Wolfe's Neck, Thomas Point Beach, Sea-Vu, etc.) - private gap is large, outside this pass

MI.estimate: Steamboat Park (108 full-hookup, Grand Rapids, family-owned) and ~150 other private campgrounds unmatched; MI holds 112 private entries

MO.estimate: ~100 Good Sam private MO campgrounds unmatched within 2 km (KOAs, Jellystones, Branson and Lake of the Ozarks RV parks); MO holds 115 private

MS.estimate: ~15 private unmatched incl. casino RV parks (Tunica, Vicksburg, Biloxi)

NC.estimate: ~120 private campgrounds unmatched (Outer Banks, mountains, Crystal Coast)

NJ.estimate: ~60 of NJ's unmatched OSM campsites are private campgrounds (Tip Tam, Wading Pines, Ocean Isle, Avalon, The Depot, Seashore Campsites...); NJ holds only 19 entries in total - private gap is large

NY.estimate: ~150 of NY's 325 unmatched named OSM campsites are private campgrounds - outside this pass

PA.estimate: 549 unmatched named OSM campsites: federal Beaver Meadows (ANF) and Ironwood Point (Brookfield utility) are real misses outside this pass; ~200 private

SC.estimate: ~60 private campgrounds unmatched, many Myrtle Beach and Upstate RV parks (Ocean Lakes, Pirateland, Lakewood, Myrtle Beach Travel Park...)

TN.estimate: ~120 private campgrounds unmatched (Pigeon Forge/Gatlinburg corridor, Cherokee Lake, Norris Lake, Big South Fork horse camps); TN holds only 57 private entries

TX.estimate: TX OSM has ~1,100 unmatched named campsites, overwhelmingly private RV parks (Permian Basin workforce parks dominate); Good Sam also lists hundreds - the private pass must filter hard for workforce/monthly parks

VA.estimate: ~60 private campgrounds unmatched (Holiday Trav-L-Park, Sun Retreats Gwynn's Island/New Point, Misty Mountain, Twin Rivers, Aquia Pines...)

WI.estimate: ~150 private unmatched (Dells, Door County, northern lakes); WI holds 78 private entries

WV.estimate: ~30 private campgrounds unmatched, many New River Gorge area (Chestnut Creek, Ray's, Thayer, Hilltop Sunrise...)

OH.estimate: ~100 Good Sam private OH campgrounds unmatched (KOAs, Jellystones among them) - see local_gap_oh_decisions.json note
